title: San Jose | Cupertino Dandiya Nite
description: Experience the Vibrancy of Navratri at the San Jose | Cupertino Dandiya Nite
long_description:
Experience the Vibrancy of Navratri at the San Jose | Cupertino Dandiya Nite
Bring out your dancing shoes for the San Jose | Cupertino Dandiya Nite. This exuberant celebration, organized by Net Effect Media, will take place on the 24th of October, 2026. Get ready to swing to the beats of Hindi, Telugu, Punjabi, English, and Gujarati music. This is not just a dance event; it's a cultural extravaganza featuring delicious Food & Drink options, Bollywood performances, and a live concert. Whether you're a Navratri/Dandiya enthusiast or a music lover, this event promises a night full of excitement, rhythm, and fun.
Artists that Enthrall and Engage
The San Jose | Cupertino Dandiya Nite does not feature a specific artist, but rest assured, the night will be filled with talented performers who will set the stage on fire. Expect a blend of traditional and modern music that will keep you on your toes. So come, be a part of this unforgettable experience and lose yourself in the enchanting world of music and dance.
Make Memories at Marriott Residence Inn
The venue for this fantastic event is the Marriott Residence Inn, located at 19429 Stevens Creek Blvd, Cupertino, CA, United States. Known for its safety and accessibility, the Residence Inn offers a perfect setting for events like ours. The venue is surrounded by a plethora of attractions and Indian restaurants like Curry House and Royal Indian Restaurant, offering you a chance to indulge in delectable cuisine before the event. Ample parking is available at the venue, ensuring a hassle-free experience for all attendees.
Secure Your Tickets Today
Don't miss out on this vibrant night of culture and entertainment. We have a range of ticket options to suit everyone. The Early Bird options include a Single ticket at $24, 4 Tickets at $88, and 10 Tickets at a deal price of $199. Regular pricing is $26 for a Single Ticket, $96 for 4 Tickets, and $220 for 10 Tickets. If you decide to join us at the last minute, tickets at the door are priced at $29 for a Single Ticket, $108 for 4 Tickets, and $249 for 10 Tickets. Grab your tickets now and join us for an unforgettable night of dancing, music, and more.
